import os
import sys
import warnings
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import re
from collections import Counter
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from scipy.sparse import hstack

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")


# Preprocess texts - extract words and clean
def preprocess(text):
    return re.sub(r"[^\w\s]", "", text.lower())


# Build vectorizer on training data only
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=5000, min_df=2, max_df=0.9, ngram_range=(1, 2), stop_words="english"
)

X_train = vectorizer.fit_transform(train["text"])
X_test = vectorizer.transform(test["text"])

# Train model
model = LogisticRegression(
    penalty="l2", C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, random_state=42
)
model.fit(X_train, train["author"].astype(str))

# Get predictions for test set
test_preds = model.predict_proba(X_test)

# Generate submission file
columns = ["id", "EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]
submissions = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test["id"].values,
        "EAP": test_preds[:, 0],
        "HPL": test_preds[:, 1],
        "MWS": test_preds[:, 2],
    }
)
submissions.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("Submission file created successfully")
